title: cis and trans [Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂]
back: Square planar $\ce{MA2B2}$: cis (Cl 90° apart, anticancer cis-platin) and trans (180°).

title: Isomers of [CoCl₂(en)₂]⁺
back: Three isomers: trans (optically inactive) and a cis pair, d and l, that are optical isomers.

title: Crystal-field splitting
back: Octahedral: $e_g$ up $0.6\Delta_o$, $t_{2g}$ down $0.4\Delta_o$. Tetrahedral: inverted and smaller, $\Delta_t=\tfrac49\Delta_o$.

title: Oxidation number of the metal
legend: neutral ligands = NH₃, H₂O, CO, en count 0
back: $\ce{K3[Fe(CN)6]}$: $x-6=-3$, so Fe is +3. Ni in $\ce{[Ni(CO)4]}$ is 0.

title: Coordination number
tex: \text{CN}=\text{number of donor atoms bonded to M}
back: Count donor atoms, not ligands: $\ce{[Co(en)3]^3+}$ has CN 6.

title: Crystal field stabilisation energy
back: Low spin when $\Delta_o>P$ (strong field); high spin when $\Delta_o<P$.

title: Werner: ions and AgCl
legend: ionisable Cl = Cl outside the bracket

title: Double salt vs complex
back: A double salt gives all its ions in water; a complex ion stays intact.
